title: Jack Rabbit Strawberry Cheesecake Nic Salt E-Liquid
description: What could be more delicious and indulgent than a rich and creamy cheesecake over a crumbly biscuit base, laced with a sweet and tangy, fresh strawberry syrup? One taste of this amazing dessert nic salt e-liquid from Jack Rabbit and you’ll be hooked. This premium e-liquid’s 50VG/50PG blend offers the perfect balance between flavour and cloud production and the nicotine salt solution makes it ideal for use in classic e-cigarette starter vape kits and pod vape devices. Perfect for recent ex-smokers or vapers seeking the immediate, satisfying nicotine relief provided by nic salts with a super-smooth throat hit.
